title: Project: Build a Complete Web Page Using HTML
description: Apply your knowledge of HTML to build a complete, structured, and well-organized web page.

quiz.question: Which HTML element represents the main content of a webpage?
quiz.explanation: The `<main>` tag specifies the main content of a document.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the `<header>` element in a webpage?
options: To contain introductory content or navigation links
quiz.correctAnswer: To contain introductory content or navigation links
quiz.explanation: `<header>` is typically used for introductory content or navigational links.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to create navigation links in a webpage?
quiz.explanation: The `<nav>` element defines a set of navigation links.

quiz.question: How do you create a hyperlink to another page in HTML?
quiz.explanation: The `<a>` tag with the href attribute creates hyperlinks.

quiz.question: Which element is best used to group related content together on a webpage?
quiz.explanation: `<section>` is used to group related content in a section.

quiz.question: What attribute should you add to the `` tag to improve accessibility?
quiz.explanation: The `alt` attribute provides alternative text for images.

quiz.question: How can you create a form section inside your webpage project?
quiz.explanation: The `<form>` tag defines an HTML form for user input.

quiz.question: Which element is used to add a footer to your webpage?
quiz.explanation: The `<footer>` element represents the footer of a document or section.

quiz.question: What is the correct way to include a comment in an HTML file?
quiz.explanation: HTML comments are enclosed within `<!--` and `-->`.

quiz.question: Which HTML5 semantic element can be used to define an independent, self-contained piece of content?
quiz.explanation: `<article>` defines a piece of content that can stand on its own.
